title: pouteria baueri
intro: Pouteria baueri, commonly known as the Black Sapote, is a tropical fruit-bearing tree native to Central and South America. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestion, due to its high antioxidant and fiber content. The therapeutic actions of Pouteria baueri are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including tannins, saponins, and flavonoids, which have anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The pulp and seeds of the Black Sapote fruit contain a rich mixture of nutrients, including vitamins, minerals, and fatty acids, making it a nutrient-rich food source.
